introduction.message:
Add WorshipTools import to Add show

Add a fourth option to the Add show popup that opens an embedded
WorshipTools Music Stand (persistent session). After signing in and
opening a service, the songs are listed in service order; the chosen
songs are read one at a time (lyrics and section tags only, no chords)
and each is created as its own show.

- Embedded WebContentsView with a read-only preload and a DOM extractor
  for the service menu and rendered charts (multi-page charts supported)
- Directions in the chart are interpreted: x2 and "Repeat Chorus" repeat
  sections, instrumental parts are removed, other directions go to notes
- Same lines per slide / auto groups / format controls as Quick lyrics,
  now shared through LyricsFormatOptions
- Destination: library only, or library and open project (service order)
- Songs that already exist in the library are skipped by default
- Tests: text builder, extractor in a real browser, and a real Electron
  run against a local mock Music Stand page

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

- Backgrounds are added in correct order

- Removing group removes selected group properly
- Changing date on auto show events works properly
- Go forward and back by 10 seconds on video

* ✨ Small changes
- Updated DMG icon
- Shows should not get deleted when not deleting
- Fixed some imported Pro7 files not formatting text properly

* ✨ Improvements
- Updated the translator info
- Overlays/templates updating properly in editor
- View multiple outputs at once in preview
- Fixed ChordPro
- Use format to a split a slide in two
- Middle mouse button selects multiple elements
- Mute audio with CTRL + M
- Audio loop
- Text editor will now only show the first text item
- Fixed some themes not deleting
- Working default stage layout slide
- Deleting group in edit will update center slide
- Fixed some Pro7 files not importing
- Scripture search improvements
- Cameras on slides works properly

* 🖼 Import custom SVG icons
- Camera item
- Rename when creating
- Select all in individual places
- CTRL + ? to open shortcuts
- Updated shortcuts
- Flip any item
- Microphones can be dragged on slides and activated
- Mics behave as normal audio
- Screens can be added as backgrounds
- Gain audio
- Bible API search working for recommended

* 📖 Updated README

* 📖 Updated README

* 🌟 Trendy lines
- Added Trendy template
- Version update

* 💾 App should not close before saving

* ✨ Fixed DMG size
- Fixed traffic light position
- Fixed freeze when some shows missing timestamps
- Updated Italian

* 🚩 Updated Polish | EN typo | DMG window section added (#222)

* Fixed typo

* 🚩 Updated Polish

* dmg windows section added

* ✨ Animations
- Scripture API books cache
- Shows in project with categories without an icon shows empty icon
- Output resolution matching slide
- Deleting more than 20 shows are now instant, but irreversable
- Audio favourites name
- Changed some icons
- Animate text style on slides
- Allow decimals in next slide timer
- Item actions: show/hide timer
- Fixed going back with output style lines set
- Transitions between images

* ✨ Item transitions
- Set specific outputs on slide change style action
- Turning off format text will not auto add groups
- Variables for custom counters and linked text
- Shows with same name in different case not allowed because of filenames
- Change number values with math expressions
- Uniform border radius
- Item transitions
- Next after media working for audio & timers too

* 🖼 Remote output screen mirror
- CSS item box updates
- Name overlay
- Properly format some specials letters from .pro import
- Output windows have the same name as the output
- Added FreeShow windows to screens menu
- Toggle servers on/off

* 📦 Backup & Restore
- Reversed items in stage display
- Multiple items in stage preview
- Stage line height matching preview
- Fixed preview filters not working sometimes
- Stage will get clock format on connetion
- List view boxes are updated when editing
- Fixed caret resetting in list view
- Changed some settings icons
- Reset all working properly
- Fixed cloud sync not working
- FreeShow import skip badly formatted files
- Importing existing songs will not change file name

* ✨ Improvements
- Fixed some pro files not importing correctly
- Only one output unmuted when playing video in multiple outputs
- Rename bibles and collections
- Place overlay under slide content
- Theme should now always load
- Rename, duplicate shortcut
- Toggle drawer with CTRL + D
- Navigate with arrow keys in all pages
- Open system folders from settings
- Show media in system

* ✨ Auto find media files
- Drawer search don't lose focus
- Escape to clear selection
- Dynamic cloud media paths
- Apply to all working for different items
- Fixed style background image not working

* 📄 Text Editor working properly!
- Fixed freeze when template was deleted
- Version update
